posts.hook: The AI tools developers trust got hit again, while the money behind AI got pickier
posts.caption: anthropic says a tampered claude code extension on cursor's marketplace was not built by it, openai trims its funding round to about $20b, the big ai labs agree on one shared opt-out signal for scraping. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: A tampered Claude Code extension sat on Cursor's marketplace for nearly 12 hours
slides.desc: At most 5,000 users got it. Anthropic says it did not build or publish that copy.

slides.title: OpenAI cuts its raise to about $20B at a ==$1.25T== valuation
slides.desc: It had sought $30B at $1.4T. The WSJ says only about $11B is committed so far.

slides.title: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic back one shared AI scraping opt-out
slides.desc: Publishers set one robots.txt rule instead of one per crawler.

slides.title: Lenders are getting choosier: neocloud bond markets have frozen for CoreWeave and peers
slides.desc: S&P also moved Meta's outlook to negative on capex and cash flow.

terms.gloss: a newer cloud company built around renting AI chips

slides.title: DoorDash says outside AI agents have placed only several hundred orders
slides.desc: A reality check on agents doing the shopping for us.
